CustomField.description: The letter from the greeting to the signature. Merge fields in double braces are replaced when the letter is generated: {{Name}}, {{Date}}, {{ApplicationNumber}}, {{MissingItems}} (a list of the application's required documents that are missing or were rejected), {{BalanceDue}} (open fees) and {{Details}} (typed by staff). A blank line starts a new paragraph.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use {{Name}}, {{Date}}, {{ApplicationNumber}}, {{MissingItems}}, {{BalanceDue}} and {{Details}}. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
CustomField.label: Body
